reviewed_by: Codex focused review of combined Butler workflows plus Notebook kernel and package control
reason: Retain prior project lifecycle, chat rewind, Notebook edit, transcript export, product knowledge, registry, and typed-action selections. Cover exact shared Library catalog and revision guards, browser-owned file selection and original-file download, reindex and removal, artifact retention, background exclusion, product-help discovery, and receipt parsing. Eight frontend files collect 98 cases for Butler browser handoffs, the workspace API client contract, and previous project/export behavior. Eight paired non-loopback LAN Library profiles cover cancellation, authenticated upload, original-byte download, revision guard, read-back, refresh, reconnect, removal, and retained artifact journey in addition to the prior 32 cases. Integrate upstream bulk chat actions: full-list selection, partial failure and retry, archive/restore, pin/flag, deletion confirmation, destination and product-help discovery, and compact toolbar geometry. Add its four Python, three frontend-file and eight paired LAN browser selections to the reviewed cumulative plan; duplicate Python tests are selected once. Add project-scoped workspace text-file listing, bounded read, hash-guarded create/edit/rename, browser-confirmed delete and byte-verified download; select its Python, browser handoff and eight paired LAN profiles. Retain the already reviewed Core chat setup responsiveness, MCP tool preparation, and stream lifecycle regressions from the concurrent main integration. This Notebook slice adds a current cell source-hash guard to Core and MCP execution, bounded recent-run discovery, and typed Butler execute and interrupt with Core run read-back. Four selected Python cases cover exact-source refusal, queued interruption, ordered replay, and mode-change coordination; the existing product-help and registry cases cover action discovery. The existing eight Notebook production-LAN browser profiles now exercise edit, exact execution, stale-hash refusal, ordered output, interrupt, refresh, and accessibility with the pinned runtime. Prior cumulative selections remain because this PR still contains those changes. Extend the selected workspace journey with browser-owned binary file selection, incremental SHA-256, directory identity and content preconditions, Core entry read-back, cancellation, folder create/rename/empty-delete, and production LAN UI verification. Select the affected Workspace API regressions, Butler tool routing, receipt parsing, browser component, exact API client header contract, and product-help discovery. Existing eight workspace LAN profiles now cover the expanded journey; no unrelated Playwright area is added. Extend the selected Notebook journey to discover and restart an exact idle kernel with file revision, kernel identity, restart count, worker acknowledgement and Core read-back; install an offline package under the project policy and read its distribution/version from the same environment. Add two Butler Notebook Python tests and the eight existing NotebookPanel component cases for the no-kernel response. Reuse the selected eight paired Notebook LAN profiles; no new browser journey is dispatched. The selected Notebook test also checks Host consent before restart. A product-help retrieval regression exposed summary passage placement; keep its existing focused query and move the consent wording beside Notebook action discovery, then rebuild the index. The Notebook LAN test reads the completed install receipt from the model request, checks the saved tool-step summary, and independently queries Core package status; saved chat history does not expose raw tool-role messages.
exclusions: No native source changed, so no native tests are selected. Unrelated Python, frontend and browser journeys are excluded. Notebook file-index control, terminal lifecycle and linked-host-folder selection, direct browser page control, evidence and reports still require separate work. Browser profiles emulate mobile devices; physical Safari and the operating system's final download save location are unavailable. Butler's enabled Knowledge setting may separately supply bounded Library excerpts to the model; the control action sends metadata only. A confirmed Library removal proves the Core item is absent and the original artifact remains; it does not independently prove every downstream index cache is cleared after an index cleanup failure. The upstream bulk chat journey is selected at its exact eight profiles; unrelated UI and Core suites remain excluded. The Notebook browser run uses the bundled pinned runtime and synthetic Host consent with network disabled; live package-network access remains outside this selected journey; the package operation installs an already available distribution offline. The new device file picker and folder actions are covered on synthetic paired LAN Core in the existing workspace profile matrix; physical Safari remains unrun. The browser upload confirmation does not prove any external filesystem consumer adopted the file. The directory identity is an optimistic precondition, not a lock against external terminal writes.
